description: ICY1 AlphaFold model confidence, PAE, contact map, and tertiary-packing benchmark against globular, IDP and fibrous controls
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
plddt=np.load("out/plddt.npy"); P=np.load("out/pae.npy"); ca=np.load("out/ca.npy")
fi=np.load("out/fi.npy"); seq=open("out/Q04329.fasta").read().split("\n")[1]

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,8.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2, height_ratios=[1,1.25], hspace=0.38, wspace=0.28)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
ax.plot(np.arange(1,128), plddt, color="#1f4e79", lw=1.8)
ax.axhline(70, color="#999", ls="--", lw=1); ax.axhline(50, color="#c44", ls=":", lw=1)
ax.axvspan(77,126, color="#1f4e79", alpha=0.10)
ax.text(101,95,"single helix 77-126", ha="center", fontsize=9, color="#1f4e79")
ax.set_ylim(20,100); ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax.set_title("AF-Q04329-F1 (ICY1) per-residue confidence\nmean pLDDT 56.7, no residue above 90", fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
im=ax.imshow(P, cmap="Greens_r", vmin=0, vmax=31, extent=[1,127,127,1])
ax.set_xlabel("scored residue"); ax.set_ylabel("aligned residue")
ax.set_title("Predicted aligned error\nmean 24.5 A; 27.7 A for |i-j| >= 12", fontsize=10)
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, label="PAE (A)", fraction=0.046)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
D=np.linalg.norm(ca[:,None]-ca[None],axis=-1)
ax.imshow((D<8.0).astype(float), cmap="Greys", extent=[1,127,127,1])
for k in (12,-12):
    ax.plot([1,127],[1+k,127+k], color="#c44", lw=1, ls="--")
ax.set_title("ICY1 CA-CA contact map (<8 A)\n0 contacts with |i-j| >= 12 (red lines)", fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("residue")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
G=pd.read_csv("out/geometry_comparison.csv")
G=G.sort_values("LR_per_res")
cols=["#c0392b" if "ICY" in l else ("#7f8c8d" if "control" in l else "#2980b9") for l in G.label]
ax.barh(range(len(G)), G.LR_per_res, color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(G))); ax.set_yticklabels([l.replace(" (","\n(") for l in G.label], fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("long-range CA contacts per residue (|i-j| >= 12, <8 A)")
ax.set_title("Tertiary packing of AlphaFold models\nICY1 and its paralog ICY2/ATG41 have none", fontsize=10)
for i,(v,r) in enumerate(zip(G.LR_per_res, G.Rg_ratio)):
    ax.text(v+0.03, i, f"Rg/Rg_glob={r}", va="center", fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_xlim(0,2.6)
plt.show()
